sample_unit: chatbot responses (40 questions x 4 chatbot versions)

links.outcome: Potentially harmful advice classification of chatbot orthodontic dietary responses
links.effect: ChatGPT Plus produced no potentially harmful responses; potentially harmful responses were identified in ChatGPT free, Gemini free, and Gemini Pro.
links.quote: Potentially harmful responses were identified in ChatGPT free version, Gemini free version, and Gemini Pro.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates LLMs (ChatGPT and Gemini versions) on patient-oriented orthodontic dietary advice evaluated by expert dentists, but does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
